run.label: LIVE — Muse Wonder
run.text: Allocate substitute alloy is the recommended recovery: it covers all 70 impacted units and finishes in 35 hours for $3,115 incremental cost. Waiting for replenishment would cost nothing extra but would finish in 83 hours, 48 hours later, while splitting capacity would finish fastest in 17.5 hours at a slightly higher $3,202.50. The certificate shows 120 each but receiving posted only 80 each, leaving a 40-each gap that remains unresolved, so the held lot stays on hold and cannot be issued. Verified substitute stock of 100 each comfortably covers the 70 units required. This rests on using the current certificate, receiving and stock quantities, snapshot hourly cell rates, and allocating only verified available substitute stock, with no supplier messaging. If replenishment were not delayed, waiting could avoid the premium, but on the current lead time it creates the longest delay.
